strongs_1890.strongs_def: pleasure; hence (abstractly) desire; concretely, a valuable thing; hence (by extension) a matter (as something in mind)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: acceptable, delight(-some), desire, things desired, matter, pleasant(-ure), purpose, willingly.
